asset_test.details: Asset Test: patient with assets exceeding 25% of household income may not be eligible; only assets accessible without penalty are considered.

evidence.quote: A patient with such assets that exceed 25% of such patient’s household income amount may not be eligible for financial assistance.
Patient applications can be submitted for consideration for up to 240 days past the date of service

presumptive_eligibility: Eligibility may be determined via presumptive scoring for patients with a sufficient unpaid balance and no FAP application; full adjustment is set at 100% of FPL.
how_to_apply: Complete the FAP Application (website, Registration Office or Business Office); phone (251) 434-3505, Mon-Fri 8 am-4:30 pm; mail USA Health, Attention: Business Office - Financial Counselor, P.O. Box 40010, Mobile, AL 36640-0010
warnings: Table boundaries overlap (up to 200%, 200-300%, 300-400%); exact boundary handling unclear.
Application deadline is stated as 240 days past date of service in Procedure B, but the Application Period definition counts 240 days after the first post-discharge billing statement; this conflicts.
Residency is not explicitly required; Covered Providers are defined by location in Mobile and Baldwin Counties, AL.
Patients with income above 400% FPL may qualify via a Means Test for catastrophic medical debt.
Policy says it applies to uninsured and/or under-insured patients; insured eligibility inferred from this.
